title: Simultaneous entry and exit on a primary distributor or integrator arterial
text: For grouped dwellings located on a designated primary distributor or integrator arterial road, driveways to allow for two vehicles to enter and exit simultaneously in forward gear. Driveways must be minimum 5.5m wide for a minimum 6.3m length (excluding manoeuvring tapers) from the street boundary (refer Figure 3.7d).

conditions.label: primary distributor or integrator arterial frontage

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New to the grouped package (no Chapter 2 twin). Applies where the site's primary street is a designated primary distributor or integrator arterial. The applicant's yes/no (site.communal_street_passing_bay) covers a driveway at least 5.5 m wide for 6.3 m from the street boundary, tapers excluded (Figure 3.7d); the same fact answers C3.7.5, so a site where both apply gives one answer for both. The 5.5 m width here exceeds nothing in C3.7.3(ii) (6 m maximum at the boundary).

verified.note: Primary distributor / integrator arterial trigger and 5.5m x 6.3m from the street boundary confirmed. Shares site.communal_street_passing_bay with C3.7.5 (passing points every 30m), so one answer covers two different requirements; the trigger reads only the primary street's class while the page says 'located on' such a road.
